CutsceneCastlePal.name: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over)
summary: Table data, then the game mode routines for modes 03, 10, 11, 16, 17, 19, 1B, 1D, 1F, 21, 23, 25 and 27 plus helpers.
$009458/$009460: palette and border image tables indexed by cutscene number [$13C6]. $009468: mode 19 (load castle cutscene or credits).
$0094FD: mode 1B (cutscene frame; mode 19 also runs it once). $00955E: decompress GFX file $2F and copy $0200 words to VRAM $4600.
$009583/$0095BC/$0095C1/$00962C/$00963D: ending modes (Yoshi's House, enemy parade, THE END). $009622: shared tail setting main/sub screen and advancing the mode.
$00968E: mode 10. $0096AE: mode 03 (load title screen; falls into the mode 11 body). $00974C: JSL wrapper for HexToDec.
$009750: mode 16. $009759: mode 17 (game over). Quirk: many ending routines have unresolved purposes (calls into bank $0C).

MarioStartGameMode.name: Game mode 11: Mario Start, level music
summary: Entered at $0096D5. Disables NMI, clears buttons, optionally shows the Mario Start message, resets overworld processing, copies layer positions,
loads the level data (CODE_05801E), picks the level music request ([$1DFB]/[$0DDA]), blacks the screen and advances the game mode.
$0097BC: Mode 7 boss room setup (called from level load): sets up screen, sprite GFX, window masks and Mario for the boss room; $009801 is the non-bit-6 variant.

s00987D.name: Mode 7 boss room: per-frame update
summary: Builds the Mode 7 matrix and runs the boss room code in bank $03 (bit 6 clear) or CODE_009A52 (bit 6 set) of [$0D9B].

s009891.name: Table: VRAM addresses for boss room tile updates
summary: Word VRAM addresses used by $0098A9 (indexed by Y = 0..$16, two bytes each).

s0098A9.name: Boss room tile animation and Mode 7 setup
summary: $0098A9: called from NMI when [$0D9B] bit 6 is set. Animated tile DMA ([$14] selects the frame, VRAM $7800) unless bit 0 is set,
then DMAs 4 or 8 byte chunks from $7E:C680 to the VRAM addresses in the table at $009891.
$009925: sets up the Mode 7 boss room (Mario position, scroll, stripe image of the room, floor tiles). $009A1F/$009A3D: fill floor map16 tiles.

s009A52.name: Boss room frame code (bit 6 set)
summary: Scroll, run boss room code (banks $05 and $02) except for boss 4, otherwise just hide the sprites.

SetUp0DA0GM4.name: Detect connected controllers into [$0DA0]
summary: Reads $4016/$4017 after auto-read. [$0DA0] = 0 or 1 (the only connected controller), or bit 7 set if both are connected (use the current player's).
$009A8B: game mode 04 (prepare title screen): level load, stripe image $03, window and color math mirrors, title circle HDMA.

s009AC8.name: Table: menu cursor movement
summary: +1 (Down), -1 (Up), -1 (both).

s009ACB.name: Menu cursor handler
summary: Reads D-pad, Select and A/B/Start, moves cursor [$1B92] within [$8A] entries (wraps), plays sounds via [$1DFC].
Quirk: returns twice (pops the caller's return address) unless B, Start or A is pressed.
Parameters: Y: cursor graphics parameter passed to CODE_009E82.
